data.spec:
Branch air-quality-stt (commit 2454044, not yet on main). Additive, no existing routes changed.
POST /api/telemetry {key:string<=64, value:number} → {accepted:boolean, metric:'temperature_c'|'humidity_pct'|'co2_ppm'|null}. Keys: th_temperature, th_humidity, anything containing "co2".
GET /api/air-quality → {level:'good'|'moderate'|'poor'|'unknown', readings:{temperature_c|humidity_pct|co2_ppm: {value, received_at}|null}, issues:string[], summary:string, stale:boolean}. Thresholds: temp 19–24 good, <17/>26 poor; humidity 25–60 good, <15/>70 poor; CO2 <1000 good, >1500 poor. In-memory latest value only.
Source: apps/server/src/environment/air.ts (registered in app.ts with registerEnvironment(app)). The bridge (apps/device/src/bridge.py forward_telemetry) posts climate readings, throttled to one per 5 s per key. Kit has no CO2 sensor, so co2_ppm is null.
